claim.text: A scoped contextual return identity absorbs all three previously recorded conditional two-layer excursions into Claude four-counter S endpoints.
claim.scope: Mathematical F1100/E/Q/N composition; 163 full raw endpoints, six mutants, 32 huge arithmetic checks, five tests and three recorded excursion matches.
assumptions: F1100 has the stated contextual mathematical derivation; it remains unformalized according to the user report.
The earlier guarded continuation and its supplied blank entry retain their prior conditional status.
The reported Lean build and current CI information have not been independently retrieved.
forbidden_promotions: No global closure, non-halting or new Lean theorem.
No equality of GPT rewrite indices with Claude move counts.

specification.intended_object: Complete contextual return from S(3u+9,1,d+7,1) to S(10u+18,2d+1,7,3) with exact time/head.
invariants: u,d are nonnegative integers; booleans rejected.
Explicit 00 before arbitrary suffix v supplies F1100 lookahead.
Intermediate two-layer words are permitted; both return endpoints fit S.
known_answer_cases: u=d=0 gives time 242, shift -18 and target S(18,1,7,3).
All three observed F1100 sources have a divisible by three.
